summary: Participation (Phase 2): the determination now actually sees standing/notes/facts, a 15-case eval suite gates the flip, and shadow mode mirrors every determination to a review channel. Everything ships disabled.
details: The grounding fix (ratified): FirePath assembles the note and fact tiers exactly the way standing already was — the participation determination's prompt now carries the <notes>/<facts> blocks its own header always claimed came with it. Wired for every fire occasion (reminders, version, compute, relay, participation), gated on [notes]/[facts] enabled, which both ship false: no shipped prompt changes anywhere until an operator enables a tier.

The eval suite (design §9): 15 cases in evals/cases/participation/ — 5 relevance-Yes, their 5 knowledge-cut twins (same message, same transcript, verdict must flip to silence when the grounding is cut), 5 pure-No. Driven through the REAL participation path (ParticipationPolicy -> ParticipationTrigger -> FirePath.speak) with per-case seeds keyed to the eval workspace, verdict graded on what the room actually heard (`sent`), plus a situation-shaped participation judge rubric (grounded value / no uninvited performance / voice).

The flip gate: `make eval-participation` runs the suite live and exits non-zero unless all 15 verdicts are correct — zero false-speaks on the knowledge-cut twins and zero speaks on the pure-No five, called out by name in the gate summary.

Shadow mode (§10.6): `[participation] shadow = true` + `shadow_channel` mirrors every determination — speak AND silence — to a dedicated channel (default platform Discord), through the same Deliverer and guards under audience="participation-shadow", never counted in nora_participation_spoke_total. Silences post what she WOULD have said: the decline draft, or — via the Deliverer's new held-text seam — the message the send cooldown held.
limitations: Inert as shipped: `[participation] enabled` and `[participation] shadow` both default false, no committed config turns either on, and no room is opted in by this change. The flip to live sends is a policy act on Miles's authorization after shadow review (design §11.1).
The live eval gate needs the LLM key env and the configured models; the judge over spoke cases is advisory (printed, never bound) so a stochastic judge cannot flake the gate.
